basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with interests in LLM reasoning and reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.

work.name: Research Intern
work.summary: Research intern working on natural language processing and machine learning.

work.name: Research Intern
work.summary: Research intern at Tencent WXG, advised by Zifei Shan.

work.name: Research Intern
work.summary: Research intern at Shanghai AI Lab, advised by Prof. Yu Cheng.

education.institution: Hong Kong University of Science and Technology

publications.name: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
publications.summary: First-author publication on synthesizing verifiable reasoning data at scale for learning logical reasoning and beyond.

publications.name: On the Perception Bottleneck of VLMs for Chart Understanding
publications.summary: First-author publication investigating the perception bottleneck of vision-language models for chart understanding. Code repository: Vision4Chart.

publications.name: On the Universal Truthfulness Hyperplane Inside LLMs
publications.summary: First-author publication presented at EMNLP 2024 on the universal truthfulness hyperplane inside LLMs. Code repository: Universal_Truthfulness_Hyperplane.

publications.name: In-Context Sharpness as Alerts: An Inner Representation Perspective for Hallucination Mitigation
publications.summary: Publication at ICML 2024 proposing an inner-representation perspective (in-context sharpness as alerts) for hallucination mitigation.
